prompt:
Pixel art character portrait for the zodiac sign ARIES: a wiry young ram, front view, head lowered ready to charge, built like a wedge: narrow hooves, big angular shoulders, two heavy spiral horns far too large for him, one ear bent, centred inside a thin-lined regular hexagon frame (all six sides equal) with short sharp flames like a starting flare behind it.

Personality, which must show in the pose and the face: headstrong, impatient, brave, first through every door, competitive but good-hearted. He leans forward on his toes, chin jutting, one eyebrow up, a cocky lopsided grin.

Mood: warm, quirky and full of character, like a hand-made indie game with its own odd style. Strong simple silhouette, bold flat shapes, an unusual body shape that suits the personality. An entirely original design: NOT in the style of any existing game or cartoon, no round blushing cheeks, no kawaii face, no big sparkly anime eyes, no pastel fluff. Eyes are small plain shapes that still carry the expression. Never fierce or scary: no fangs, no snarl.

Style: 16-bit console pixel art, hard square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, no dithering. Drawn on a 96 x 96 pixel grid, shown enlarged so each pixel is a clear square. Thick dark outline around every shape. The whole image has a flat solid BLACK background, edge to edge; no white anywhere outside the character.

Palette: exactly four bright flat colours plus black: cream, tomato red, orange, navy blue. At most two flat shades of each, nothing else.

Composition: symmetrical, the character fills about 60% of the frame, eyes and mouth drawn as clearly separate shapes. Square image, no text, no letters, no watermark, no signature.
